title: Songbook and Kitchen
author: Theo Ishikawa
blurb: Marguerite Eastwick, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, has spent ten years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
